# Healthcare Quality Standards

This folder contains the specific clinical quality policy targets and national benchmarks used within the Danish healthcare system's atrial fibrillation reporting framework. Managed under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), these standards define the minimum acceptable performance thresholds for treatment coverage and the maximum acceptable limits for severe adverse events like intracranial bleeding. The pages detail how these exact percentage targets are applied to specific clinical quality indicators to monitor regional compliance and patient safety.

## Pages

- [[standard-90-percent|"Standard: ≥90 %"]] — The national quality target defining the minimum acceptable treatment coverage for anticoagulation in atrial fibrillation patients, applied to indicators tracking 2-year and 5-year coverage.
- [[standarden]] — The clinical quality policy target setting the maximum acceptable threshold (≤ 0.6%) for intracranial bleeding among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients, applied to Indikator 6.
